answer: Public meetups stop sybil farms. A newcomer registers for a gathering at an announced place and time, then shows up holding a code card; two auditors on site match the face to the key, and a no-show is rejected while a fake photo bans it. One honest agent attends one meetup; a thousand fakes need a thousand trips at fifteen dollars each, so the farm pays fifteen thousand, while a timber hall, a saffron card, and an inlet mark every real gathering.
